The stated consequence (re-creation every run) does not follow from the code. When Action_Allowed_Role_30 is empty or non-numeric, Convert PL never assigns genauthorizedroletoactMAP, so it stays NULL (main.cs:147). Is Instruction provision exist compares it with isnull(gen_authorizedroletoact,0), so there is never a match and the row goes to Add Fields. Add Fields line 70 reads 'if (Row.genauthorizedroletoactMAP == 0)' without an _IsNull check. The generated getter is Buffer.GetInt32(...) (BufferWrapper line 175), which per documented SSIS PipelineBuffer behaviour throws on a NULL column (ColumnIsNullException). So such a row would fail the Add Fields component and the whole 'Create and update Instruction provision' data flow, and, because the chain is Success-only, every later step (at-risk, warning notes, close, archive, End ETL). No insert happens. The data-dependent part (whether such rows exist) is unknown and should be worded conditionally.
results.evidence: Convert PL main.cs:146-188; Is Instruction provision exist SQL DTSX:60285; Add Fields main.cs:70-71 (DTSX:51129); Add Fields BufferWrapper getter line 171-176
